card.name: Historical phrases and names in general text
card.fires_on: Negative on words inside set historical phrases or names, such as 'Great' before Leap or Depression, 'Leap' in Great Leap Forward, and 'draws to a close'. Also on name endings like Lindbergh and Allman, and on 'move' as a noun or verb of political or military action.

modes.label: Great Leap / Great Depression
modes.description: The word 'Great' or 'Leap' inside the named historical events.
modes.example: He initiated the Great<< Leap>> Forward in the 1950

modes.label: Ends of surnames
modes.description: The last piece of a person's surname split into parts.
modes.example: Charles Lindber<<gh>> became the most famous human being on earth

modes.label: 'Move' as an action
modes.description: The word move or moving describing a political or military step.
modes.example: his political beliefs veered sharply to the left, a<< move>> that was reflected in the style and content

card.plain: It fires on words within well-known historical phrases and on the ends of some surnames.
